I’m looking for creative talent to build our visual identity, starting with its core: the studio logo. 
OOBE stands for OUT OF BOUNDS ENCOUNTER. The name itself acts as a narrative trigger. It evokes that eerie moment when a player breaches the safe geometry of a virtual environment and meets the unexplainable - an unexpected presence in the void, an interaction with something that was never meant to exist. An exo-suited null-diver reaching across the cosmic edge colliding with his chromatic antithesis.… I want our logo to carry that imaginative narration, that exact same provocative weight.
When I picture our studio logo, I think less about "playful indie" and more about cyber-brutalism meets Tokyo-noir in negative space. Based on our visual anchors, I tend to picture a cold, monochromatic, iconic feel to the mark, but I don't shy away from a contrasty color accent that may underline the studio's visual statement.
My inspirations are the tech-brutalism of Kojima Productions, the Lovecraftian suspense of Nightdive Studios, and the cold, raw punch of tech-punk aesthetics from ACRNM. If the logo were a playlist, it would land somewhere between "Fleure" by Autechre and “Intro (The Full Horror) by SOPHIE.

ofertas.titulo: Modern B2B Business Brand Identity Design
ofertas.descripcion:
My new B2B venture needs a complete brand identity that speaks clearly to business owners and professionals. The aesthetic must be clean and modern—minimal clutter, balanced white space, refined typography—and remain consistent across every touchpoint.
Scope of work
• Logo design from concept to final artwork
• Curated color palette with HEX, RGB, and CMYK codes
• Primary and secondary font pairings with licensing guidance
• Concise visual style guide covering correct usage, spacing, and sizing
• Deliverables supplied as editable vectors (AI, EPS, SVG) plus ready-to-use PNG and PDF files
Acceptance criteria
• Three distinct logo concepts to start, with two revision rounds on the chosen direction
• Final assets that scale crisply for print and digital, maintain legibility at small sizes, and align with the defined clean-modern feel
Please include a portfolio that demonstrates an ability to translate complex ideas into simple, sophisticated visuals and outline your estimated timeline for each milestone.

ofertas.titulo: E-Commerce Website, Packaging, And AI Visual Design
ofertas.descripcion:
The core of the job is to bring my half-finished online shop across the finish line before we move on to packaging and the AI-driven side of the business.
First, I need you to refine every customer-facing area of the site. The product pages and their imagery, the shopping basket and checkout flow, plus the homepage, menus, and overarching style all need that final professional polish so the store feels cohesive and ready for launch.
Once the shop looks and feels complete, we’ll shift to two additional tasks: refreshing our product packaging and creating the hero visuals and UI components that sit around our AI models on a separate site. Think clean, modern graphics that resonate with a British audience and keep usability at the forefront.
I’m looking for someone with at least two years in graphic or visual design and a portfolio that shows a sharp eye for detail, strong typography, and an understanding of e-commerce best practices. If you’re comfortable working in tools like Figma, Adobe XD, Illustrator, or Photoshop and can turn feedback into quick iterations, you’ll be a great fit.
Quality is key but speed matters too, so clear communication and timely updates will keep the project moving smoothly. Share a link to work you’re proud of, and let’s get this shop looking its best.
